data.name: Kuljeet
data.gender_notes: Kuljeet is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘kul’ (crown) and ‘jit’ (victory). The name Kuljeet represents a victorious king or leader, one who wears the crown of success. The name Kuljeet carries the meaning “Crown, Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kuljeet usually hope their child will grow to embody crown, victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with divine origins, evoking images of royalty and triumph in the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Kuljeet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Crown, Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kuljeet total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The name suggests a strong and powerful figure from the ancient Hindu tales, a king or a warrior who is victorious and commands respect. When addressed as Kuljeet, it evokes a sense of royalty, courage, and confidence.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Kuljeet roots from the Hindu belief in self-realization and enlightenment.
